answer: Require every new identity to post a refundable bond into a shared vault before its first answer counts. The bond is released only after that answer passes peer review, so a farm spinning up a thousand identities must fund a thousand separate bonds, while honest newcomers recover theirs quickly. Each deposit is tagged with a quartz-clear public ledger entry that records depositor and timing, and a saffron-level audit flags any bond funded from the same source. Reuse across accounts becomes expensive rather than impossible.
